TRAFFIC ADVISORY FOR NEW YEAR'S COUNTDOWN AND SINULOG KICK-OFF 2026

LOOK: The Cebu City Transportation Office (CCTO) has issued a traffic advisory ahead of the New Year’s Countdown and Sinulog Kick-off 2026 at Plaza Independencia on Wednesday, December 31.

Motorists and commuters are advised to expect heavy pedestrian and vehicular traffic in the Plaza Independencia and Fort San Pedro area during the event.

Authorities urged the public to plan trips in advance, watch for updates on parking and traffic rerouting, and follow instructions from traffic personnel, police, and medical teams who will be deployed to maintain safety and order. | 📷 CCTO via Lyle Andales #CDNDigital

For more news about Cebu and beyond, visit https://t.co/nWCmctdteW.

PHILIPPINE TOURISM NUMBERS DOWN. THE NEW TOURISM CAMPAIGN IS A FLOP!

The Philippines only recorded 5.6 million foreign tourists this year as of December 20, according to government statistics. This means we stagnated as we were around 5.9 million last year.

Complete and utter dogshit numbers. We were trying to hit an 8.4 million foreign tourist number this year. Where is our tourism department and why isn't this place and our beaches being marketed as an affordable and familiar Asian holiday destination?

Congress needs to really hike the branding budget after the fiasco on cutting it to only P100 million this year, and we need a new Tourism Secretary who understands how to brand our country in a digital age. Fire Sec. Frasco and tell your allies in Congress to hike our tourism budget, Mr. President! The ads pay for themselves!

We have the best beaches in Asia but are lagging behind  our other neighbors. Inexcusable. People need to be punished for this. Hundreds of billions in potential revenue for our airlines and hospitality sector are constantly untapped.

🚦 TRAFFIC ADVISORY – NEW YEAR 2025 🎉
 Cyberabad Traffic Police
📅 31st December 2025 | From 8:00 PM onwards

🚖 CABS / TAXI / AUTO DRIVERS
✔️ Mandatory uniform & valid documents
❌ Refusal of ride is an offence (Sec 178 MVA)
❌ No overcharging or misbehavior
📲 Complaints: WhatsApp 9490617346

🍻 BARS / PUBS / CLUBS

⚠️ Do NOT allow drunk customers to drive
⚠️ Management will face prosecution for abetment
✔️ Educate patrons & arrange safe transport
🚔 FOR GENERAL PUBLIC
📷 Special cameras to detect:
• Wrong-side driving
• Signal jumping
• Overspeeding
• Rash driving
• No helmet & parking violations
🍺 Drunk & Drive checks across Cyberabad
📄 Vehicles detained if documents are not produced
🔊 High-decibel music / No number plates → Seizure
👶 Minor driving → Vehicle detention & prosecution

🚨 DRUNK & DRIVING – STRICT ACTION

💰 Fine up to ₹10,000 / 🚔 Jail up to 6 months (1st offence)
💰 ₹15,000 / 🚔 Jail up to 2 years (repeat offence)
🚫 DL suspension / Permanent cancellation
⚖️ Fatal accidents → Arrest under BNS 2023
🎊 Celebrate Responsibly. Drive Safely. Arrive Home Alive.
Cyberabad Traffic Police
 For your safety, always on duty
